pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
[Female Vocal - airy whisper + soft hum]
(soft pulsing pads, distant water-drop pluck, wide reverb, rising stage atmosphere)

Put your hands up… right now…
Are you ready… let’s fly…

[Verse 1]
[Female Vocal]
(behind-the-beat, breathy, locked to kick/snare)

Back on stage, lights hit my face
I breathe deep even when my hands shake
It’s okay to tremble, it’s okay to fall
This time I’m doing it for me, that’s all

[Pre-Chorus]
[Female Vocal]
(sub bass follows kick, minimal pads)

Tears turn into laughter in a second
I can hear my heartbeat calling
Everything’s gonna change now

[Hook]
[Female Vocal - phonetic loop]
(slight silence before, then full groove impact)

Rise again… I rise again
Step by step… I’m flying high
Hands up… scream it loud
This is my moment… my time

[Chorus]
[Female Vocal]
(repeat hook with layered airy ad-libs)

Rise again… I rise again
This is my stage… I own the light
Hands up everybody… feel the fire
From now on… it’s a brand new start

[Verse 2]
[Female Vocal]
(more textured rasp, close mic)

Yesterday’s tears have all dried up
Tomorrow’s me is waiting there
The girl in the mirror is smiling now
I’m finally learning how to love myself

[Pre-Chorus 2]
[Female Vocal]
(pads pulse stronger)

Throw away the fear, leave it behind
It’s only me shining on this stage
Everybody shout it with me

[Hook 2]
[Female Vocal]
(stronger groove, add light vocal fry)

Rise again… I rise again
This is my stage… I own the light
Hands up everybody… feel the fire
From now on… it’s a brand new start

[Chorus 2]
[Female Vocal]
(full layers, humming in background)

Rise again… I rise again
Piano carries my dreams to the sky
I scream it out… with all of me
I woke up… I’m flying free

[Bridge]
[Female Vocal - half-whisper]
(everything drops to sub bass + soft pads)

Even if tears fall… it’s alright
Laughing while crying… feels right
This moment is my whole life…

[Rap]
[Female Vocal - low, breathy, close]
(exact drum interlock, behind snare)

I woke up again, また起きた, เธอตื่นแล้ว
Tears falling but I’m still standing tall
This is my first and last love… for myself
No more holding back, I’m breaking the walls
Yeah… I rise again…

[Break]
[Instrumental + Humming]
(only water-drop pluck + pulsing pads, airy hums)

[Final Chorus]
[Female Vocal]
(max layers, rich reverb)

Rise again… I rise again
I’m the light… I’m the main character
Everybody hands up… scream it loud
I woke up… I’m flying now

[Outro]
[Female Vocal - fading]
(heavy reverb, last syllable fry, slow fade)

I rise again… I rise again…
(soft humming till end)
pkg.sunoStyle: Groovy airy electro-pop with groove. Minimal, rhythm-driven, laid-back, subtly sensual. Tempo: 92 BPM, slight swing, behind-the-beat feel. Drums: kick on 1 and 3, ghost kicks between; snare/clap on 2 and 4. Arrangement: resonant sub bass follows kick, pulsing pads drive rhythm, water-drop pluck for melody. Sound: clean airy mix, controlled reverb, soft delay, wide stereo. Vocal: female, distinct raspy, airy-textured, mature tone. Texture: pronounced rasp, audible vocal fry, slight grit. Style: spoken word, rap cadence. NOT singing. Rules: no melody, no sustain. Each word separate. Hard stop each phrase. Timing: lock to beat grid, words align with kick/snare hits. Phrasing: choppy, staccato, clipped, groove-synced. Delivery: percussive, consonant-driven. Pitch: near-monotone. Flow: relaxed, slightly behind snare but locked. Ending: last syllable extended, raspy breathy fade with fry. Core: drum-locked spoken vocal over bass, pads, water pluck.
